RFC5709-3-5.note: Rejudged 2026-10-21 over the current tags, units and records. The redundant codec-level tag was removed. TestRFC5709AnyAlgorithmUnderAnyKeyID rotates all five algorithms over Key IDs 1, 77, 200, 254 and 255 through parseOSPFConfig, validateConfig and the engine verifyPacket hook, with no auth failure. The row's {single-polarity: positive} holds: the MUST is permissive and has no forbidden pairing to reject.

RFC5709-3.1-1.note: (a) forbidden: sending an HMAC-SHA packet whose Authentication Type is not Cryptographic Authentication (2); (b) TestEngineSignPacketCrypto asserts the on-wire AuType of eng.signPacket output equals AuTypeCryptographic; negative TestOSPFAuthStoreSignVerify asserts a non-crypto AuType packet is refused under crypto config

RFC5709-3.1-3.note: Re-judged 2026-10-21 after the AuType 2 replay slot became per neighbour (replaySlotFor). Positive TestRFC5709CryptoSequenceNonDecreasingOnInterface signs five Hellos through signPacket across a key change and fails on any sequence below the last sent on eth0 (RFC 2328 D.4.3 (5) 'non-decreasing'). Negative TestOSPFAuthReplay, AuType 2: seq 5 after 11 is dropped with reason replay, per D.5.3 (2) 'less than ... discarded'; equal 11 is accepted. replayedSequence returns seq < last for AuType 2. Both polarities stand.

RFC5709-3.2-1.note: (a) forbidden: a new key whose KeyStartGenerate is after the old key's KeyStopGenerate; (b) TestKeyRolloverGapRejected asserts validateConfig returns ErrKeyRolloverGap for start 2026-03-01 after end 2026-02-01, and TestKeyRolloverOverlapAccepted asserts an overlapping rollover validates. The equal-time boundary is not exercised

RFC5709-3.2-2.note: Re-judged 2026-09-30 (continuation 8, judge): row narrowed per R35 to the MUST NOT (no revert to an unauthenticated condition); the 'not advisable to disrupt routing' clause moved to RFC5709-3.2-5. Positive TestRFC5709LastKeyExpiredStillSigns: only key's send and accept lifetimes over, a Hello through eng.signPacket leaves AuType 2 Key ID 1; positive TestSignKeyNoRevertWhenAllExpired (store level). Negative TestRFC5709LastKeyExpiredRefusesUnauthenticated: AuType 0 Hello refused by verify with autype-mismatch after expiry. All three revert records (selectSendKey, verify) re-recorded by the judge after continuation 8 changed those producers, observed red.

RFC5709-3.2-5.note: New row 2026-09-30 (R35, D-8 fixed). auth_keystore.go: lastKeyIndex (latest sendStart, tie -> later accept end) is shared by signer and verifier; selectSendKey signs with it when no key is active; lastKeyExtendedIndex extends its accept window only when every window of the chain has closed and the last key's accept end passed (a not-yet-open chain is not expiry); noticeLocked notifies once per interface until configure installs a new chain; notification = slog Warn + ospf/last-key-expiration event. Positive TestRFC5709LastKeyExpiredKeepsAdjacency: two engines with the same expired one-key chain, two Hellos signed by one verify on the other, exactly one event each (eth0, key 1, send / receive). Negative TestRFC5709ExpiredKeyRefusedOnceNotLast: after a live Key ID 2 is configured the expired Key ID 1 is refused accept-lifetime, the signer moves to Key ID 2, no event. Revert records on lastKeyExtendedIndex observed red for both polarities. 'Lifetime extended' and 'key deleted' are the same configure path as 'new key configured' and are not separately asserted.

RFC5709-3.2-6.note: RFC 5709 Section 3.2: 'Key storage SHOULD persist across a system restart, warm or cold'. The positive commits the key chain through config.LoadConfig, SerializeSet, storage.WriteCandidateVersion and PromoteCandidate into an on-disk store and closes it. It then reopens the store with storage.Open and ReadActiveConfig (the cmd/ze/hub/config_source.go read) and requires Key ID 1 to sign, with a neighbour holding the plaintext key accepting the Hello. A serializer, store or reader that lost or altered the key turns it red, and the untagged TestRFC5709AlteredStoredKeyRefused control shows the neighbour checks the key itself. The {single-polarity: positive} annotation is sound. The SHOULD constrains the implementation's storage, not a received input, so no input exists that Ze could accept or refuse in violation, and a negative could only be fault injection into the store. The annotation names PromoteCandidate, the producer the positive's discrimination record breaks.
RFC5709-3.2-6.upgrade_reason: The weak verdict rested only on the former negative tag, which persisted a different key correctly and so did not violate this requirement. The author removed that tag and its record and annotated the row single-polarity positive. I re-read the positive unit and the new annotation. The positive already enforced the persistence claim, and the annotation's argument holds, so nothing remains to keep the verdict weak.

RFC5709-3.3-5.note: Judged 2026-10-21 over current tags, units and records. Quote verified in RFC 5709 Section 3.3 ('Apad is the hexadecimal value 0x878FE1F3 repeated (L/4) times'), split from the Apad fill obligation of 3.3-1. The positive requires the signed trailer to equal a digest built independently with that literal Apad for every L. The negative refuses a digest made over a zero-filled trailer. Both records are on apad.

RFC5709-3.4-1.note: Re-judged 2026-10-21. Codec tests (TestOSPFAuthSignVerifyCrypto, TestRFC5709ReceiveIndependentDigest, TestRFC5709ReceiveRejectsWrongHashConstruction, TestOSPFAuthCryptoChecksumOctetAuthenticated) changed only by added comment tags: Verify accepts an independently built HMAC-SHA digest with Apad and rejects altered digests, wrong constructions and a changed checksum octet. TestEngineReceiveSelectsSecurityAssociation now offsets each case's sequences by 1000 because AuType 2 keeps one sequence per neighbour; the valid/forged/next assertions are unchanged and the 'next' check still reddens if a forged packet advanced replay state. No discrimination records; judged by reading.

RFC5709-3.4-2.note: Re-judged 2026-10-21. TestOSPFAuthCryptoRejectsKeyIDMismatch (codec) unchanged: a non-matching Key ID fails even with the same secret, a matching one verifies. TestEngineReceiveSelectsSecurityAssociation: Key IDs 7 (SHA-256), 8 (SHA-512), 9 (other secret); each valid packet passes, an unknown Key ID and another association's algorithm or secret are dropped and counted. The only change is per-case sequence offsets for the per-neighbour AuType 2 slot, which leaves every assertion intact.
